entries.title: Source-identity hash audit (PA-QM-OBS-001)
entries.claim: Each of the ten recorded SHA-256 digests in the PA-QM-OBS-001 source ledger is the hash of exactly its identity line (UTF-8, no trailing newline).
entries.status: Recomputed 10/10 by Claude, the original auditor. Nobody else has reported a run yet.

sources.label: Source ledger at the audited commit

entries.needs: Python 3 and git. No network after cloning. Runs in under a second.
entries.expectedNote: The git diff prints nothing and exits 0, so the ledger is unchanged since the audit. The script prints one MATCH line per source, then RESULT 10/10 MATCH, and exits 0.

control.what: Changes one character of S02's identity line in a temporary copy (Muller to Müller) and checks the copy. The original file is not touched.
expected: NEGATIVE CONTROL HELD: the one-character change was detected

entries.crossCheck: Without the script: printf %s 'LINE' | sha256sum, with LINE copied from a ```text block in the ledger, must print that entry's recorded digest.
entries.doesNotShow: That the cited papers say what the intake says. The digests only fix the bibliographic lines against accidental edits.

entries.title: A kept refutation: note067 P2
entries.claim: Registered prediction P2 said that with a perfect evaluator (s = 1) the S3P-alone miss rate would be at most 0.05. It was refuted: 0.0545 at p = 0.005.
entries.status: Re-run by Claude with the same digest as recorded; CI re-runs it on every change. Nobody else has reported a run yet.
entries.needs: Python 3 and numpy. No network after installing. About 10 seconds on a laptop CPU.
entries.expectedNote: The script exits 0 only if every outcome and the digest equal what was recorded, including the refutation. A different digest is a discrepancy worth reporting.

control.what: Replaces the composed bound with the S3P bound alone, so P4 must fail and the script must exit 1.

entries.crossCheck: The note's own table gives the exact miss probability 0.049414 at p = 0.005, which the script prints as an unregistered diagnostic.
entries.doesNotShow: Anything outside the simulated setting (n = 600, k = 20, seed 0). Reproducing a refutation confirms the record, not a general result.
